module_name_en: Core Words III and Graded Reading
block_note: The formal register block is taught as the parts of a document — the verbs an office uses, the header of a letter, and its closing — rather than as twelve unrelated words. By level 21 a learner can read the skeleton of any official Hindi letter.

learn.title_en: समर्थन — backing a position, not helping a person
learn.explanation_en: समर्थन is support in the sense of endorsement: you back a proposal, a policy or a candidate. It is not मदद, which is practical help given to a person. It is masculine and consonant-final, so flag it, and it takes का on the thing supported — नीति का समर्थन — exactly as विरोध did in level 13. The two are a matched pair with the same shape and opposite directions, and समर्थक is the person who supports.

examples.hindi: सरकार ने प्रस्ताव का समर्थन किया।
examples.read_as: sarkaar ne prastaav kaa samarthan kiyaa.
examples.note: का on the thing supported, and किया masculine.
मिलना for receiving, with a dative on the receiver.

examples.hindi: मैं इस विचार का समर्थक हूँ।
examples.read_as: maiṁ is vichaar kaa samarthak huuṁ.
examples.note: समर्थक, the person. विचार goes oblique before का.

common_error.why_en: समर्थन is masculine, so करना agrees with it.

practice.prompt_en: Which postposition marks the thing supported?
practice.explanation_en: प्रस्ताव का समर्थन — the same shape as नीति का विरोध.

game.question_en: Which word means practical help given to a person?
game.explanation_en: मदद is hands-on help. सहयोग is cooperation, and हिमायत is advocacy on somebody's behalf.

tts_strings: सरकार ने प्रस्ताव का समर्थन किया।

learn.title_en: मुद्दा — the issue, not the question
learn.explanation_en: मुद्दा is a point in contention — the thing being argued about. It is not सवाल, which is a question somebody asks, and not मामला, which is a matter or an affair being dealt with. News writing uses मुद्दा constantly: चुनावी मुद्दे, election issues. It ends in -आ and is masculine, so the gender is predictable, and the verb is उठाना — you raise an issue, as in English.

examples.note: असली, invariable, and मुद्दा masculine.
उठाना, to raise. Not पूछना, which is for questions.

examples.hindi: चुनाव में यही मुद्दा छाया रहा।
examples.read_as: chunaav meṁ yahii muddaa chhaayaa rahaa.
examples.english: This was the dominant issue in the election.
examples.note: छाया रहना, to loom over or dominate.

common_error.why_en: सवाल is asked; मुद्दा is raised. The verb is part of the word.

practice.explanation_en: मुद्दा उठाना — to raise an issue.

game.question_en: Which word means a matter or affair being dealt with?
game.explanation_en: मामला is the affair itself. मुद्दा is what is contentious about it, and सवाल is a question.

learn.title_en: निष्कर्ष निकालना — the same metaphor in both languages
learn.explanation_en: निष्कर्ष is निः- (out) plus कर्ष (drawing), so it means a drawing-out — and the verb that goes with it is निकालना, to draw out. English does exactly the same thing when it says draw a conclusion. The two languages arrived at the same picture independently, which is rare enough to be worth noticing and makes this one easy to remember. It is masculine and consonant-final, so flag it. And निष्- here is the same prefix as निष्पक्ष in level 13 and निःशुल्क on the sign in level 7.

examples.note: निकलना, the intransitive — the conclusion emerges by itself.
निकालना, the transitive — you draw it out.
का because निष्कर्ष is masculine.

common_error.why_en: निष्कर्ष goes with निकालना, not करना. The word itself means a drawing-out.

practice.explanation_en: निः- out, plus कर्ष drawing — which is why the verb is निकालना.

game.question_en: Which word means the outcome of something rather than the conclusion drawn from it?
game.explanation_en: परिणाम is the result, what actually happened. निष्कर्ष is what you conclude from looking at it.

summary.recap_en: समर्थन and विरोध are a matched pair — both take का on the thing, both go with करना. मुद्दा is raised, not asked. And निष्कर्ष is literally a drawing-out, which is why it goes with निकालना and why English draws a conclusion too.
summary.next_up_en: Next: the vocabulary of official writing, starting with three adjectives that never change.

learn.explanation_en: आवश्यक is the formal word for necessary, and ज़रूरी is what people say. Both are entirely correct; a form says आवश्यक and a friend says ज़रूरी. It is invariable, like every Sanskrit-derived adjective of this shape. You have already met its relatives: आवश्यकता, the noun, appeared as the formal partner of ज़रूरत back in level 1, and अनावश्यक, unnecessary, turned up when the अ- prefix was introduced in level 12.

examples.note: An infinitive as the subject, and आवश्यक does not agree with anything.
जानकारी is feminine, and आवश्यक still does not change.

examples.english: Let us know if it becomes necessary.
examples.note: The oblique infinitive plus पर again, and the noun from level 1.

common_error.why_en: There is no feminine form. आवश्यक is invariable.

practice.prompt_en: How would a friend say आवश्यक?
practice.explanation_en: ज़रूरी is the everyday word. अनिवार्य is even more formal and means compulsory.

game.question_en: Which word means compulsory rather than merely necessary?
game.explanation_en: अनिवार्य is compulsory — there is no choice. अनावश्यक is unnecessary and उपयोगी is useful.

learn.title_en: उपलब्ध — a formal word with no everyday twin
learn.explanation_en: उपलब्ध means available, and this is the first formal word in the module that has no casual counterpart. Speech does not swap it for another adjective; it rewrites the sentence. ये उपलब्ध है becomes ये मिल जाएगा or simply ये है. That is worth knowing, because a learner who goes looking for the everyday version of every formal word will sometimes be looking for something that does not exist. You have seen उपलब्ध twice already, on the toilet sign in level 8 and the ticket window in level 16.

examples.hindi: ये सुविधा भूतल पर उपलब्ध है।
examples.read_as: ye suvidhaa bhuutal par uplabdh hai.
examples.english: This facility is available on the ground floor.
examples.note: The exact line from the level 8 sign.
Plural verb, and उपलब्ध still unchanged.

examples.hindi: अभी कोई कमरा उपलब्ध नहीं है।
examples.read_as: abhii koii kamraa uplabdh nahiiṁ hai.
examples.english: No room is available at the moment.
examples.note: A hotel would say this on a board; the man at the desk would say कमरा नहीं है.

common_error.wrong: क्या ये उपलब्ध है? — said to a shopkeeper
common_error.why_en: Grammatically fine, but nobody talks like that in a shop. Rewrite rather than translate.

practice.prompt_en: How would speech express ये उपलब्ध है?
practice.explanation_en: Speech changes the sentence rather than the adjective.

game.question_en: Which word from the same root means an achievement?
game.explanation_en: उपलब्धि is an achievement — something attained. उपस्थिति is attendance and उपयोग is use.

tts_strings: अभी कोई कमरा उपलब्ध नहीं है।

learn.title_en: संबंधित विभाग — the department concerned, and nobody in particular
learn.explanation_en: संबंध is a connection or a relationship, masculine; संबंधित is the adjective built from it, and it is invariable. संबंधित विभाग से संपर्क करें — contact the department concerned — is one of the most characteristic sentences in Indian officialdom, and part of its function is to avoid naming anybody. Recognising that phrase is worth more than the word alone, because it tells you the notice is declining to be more specific.

examples.hindi: कृपया संबंधित विभाग से संपर्क करें।
examples.read_as: kripayaa saṁbaṁdhit vibhaag se saṁpark kareṁ.
examples.note: संपर्क करना takes से on the person or body contacted.

examples.hindi: ये मामला उससे संबंधित नहीं है।
examples.read_as: ye maamlaa usse saṁbaṁdhit nahiiṁ hai.
examples.english: This matter isn't related to that.
examples.note: से on the thing it relates to.
संबंध is masculine, so हमारे and अच्छे.

practice.prompt_en: संबंधित विभाग से संपर्क करें means what?
practice.explanation_en: And notably, it does not say which department.

game.question_en: Which word means getting in touch?
game.explanation_en: संपर्क is contact. संबंध is a standing relationship, and संगठन is an organisation.

tts_strings: कृपया संबंधित विभाग से संपर्क करें।

summary.recap_en: आवश्यक is ज़रूरी in formal dress. उपलब्ध has no everyday twin at all — speech rewrites the sentence instead of swapping the word. And संबंधित विभाग is officialdom's way of not naming anybody.
summary.next_up_en: Next: the verbs an office uses, and the opening of a formal request.

learn.title_en: प्रस्तुत करना — to put something before somebody
learn.explanation_en: प्रस्तुत करना is to present or submit — a report, a case, a document. It is formal only, and the everyday equivalent is पेश करना, which is itself Urdu-side. Notice what that means: the pair here is not formal against casual so much as Sanskrit-side against Urdu-side, and the Urdu-side one happens to be the one people say. Register in Hindi is rarely a single ladder, which is what Module 15 will spend twelve levels on.

examples.note: पक्ष from level 13, masculine, so किया.
दस्तावेज़ — document, masculine, and Urdu-side inside a Sanskrit-side sentence.
सबूत is masculine plural here, so किए.

common_error.why_en: रिपोर्ट is feminine, so करना agrees with it.

practice.prompt_en: What is the everyday equivalent of प्रस्तुत करना?
practice.explanation_en: पेश करना — and it is Urdu-side, not casual Hindi as such.

game.explanation_en: प्रस्ताव is a proposal. प्रस्थान is departure, which you met at the ticket window in level 16.

learn.title_en: सूचित — built from the सूचना you met on a notice
learn.explanation_en: सूचना was the word at the top of the lift notice in level 14; सूचित is the adjective built from it, and सूचित करना is to inform. The whole family is worth having at once: सूचना information or a notice, सूचित informed, सूची a list, सूचक an indicator. Formal writing prefers सूचित करना where speech simply says बताना — and the difference is not politeness but setting, because बताना is perfectly polite.

examples.note: The person informed takes को, fused here into हमें.

examples.hindi: हमने सभी को सूचित कर दिया है।
examples.read_as: hamne sabhii ko suuchit kar diyaa hai.
examples.note: ने, and the देना vector for a completed outward action.

examples.hindi: उन्होंने समय पर सूचित नहीं किया।
examples.read_as: unhoṁne samay par suuchit nahiiṁ kiyaa.
examples.english: They did not inform us in time.
examples.note: समय पर, on time — पर for a point in time.

common_error.why_en: You inform somebody with सूचित करना. To have been informed, the natural phrase is सूचना मिलना.

practice.prompt_en: Which is the everyday verb for सूचित करना?
practice.explanation_en: बताना. It is not less polite — only less official.

game.question_en: Which word from the same family means a list?
game.explanation_en: सूची is a list, feminine. सूचक is an indicator, and सूचना is information or a notice.

tts_strings: हमने सभी को सूचित कर दिया है।

learn.title_en: निवेदन है कि — how a formal request begins
learn.explanation_en: निवेदन is a request made upwards — to an authority, an office, somebody in a position to grant it. The standard shape is निवेदन है कि, "it is requested that", and it opens a great many Indian letters. It is masculine and consonant-final, so flag it. अनुरोध, which you will meet as a reading target in level 24, means the same thing but is level rather than deferential; a colleague sends an अनुरोध and a citizen sends a निवेदन.

examples.hindi: आपसे निवेदन है कि जल्दी उत्तर दें।
examples.read_as: aapse nivedan hai ki jaldii uttar deṁ.
examples.english: You are requested to reply promptly.
examples.note: आपसे — the request goes from you to them, so से.

examples.hindi: मेरा एक छोटा सा निवेदन है।
examples.read_as: meraa ek chhoṭaa saa nivedan hai.
examples.note: मेरा masculine, and सा softening as it did in Module 12.

examples.hindi: उनका निवेदन स्वीकार कर लिया गया।
examples.read_as: unkaa nivedan sviikaar kar liyaa gayaa.
examples.note: स्वीकार करना, to accept — another करना compound.

common_error.why_en: निवेदन is masculine despite the consonant ending.

practice.explanation_en: It is the standard opening of a letter asking for something.

game.question_en: Which word is a request between equals rather than one made upwards?
game.explanation_en: अनुरोध is level in tone. आदेश is an order, going the other way, and सुझाव is a suggestion.

tts_strings: आपसे निवेदन है कि जल्दी उत्तर दें।
मेरा एक छोटा सा निवेदन है।

summary.recap_en: प्रस्तुत करना and पेश करना are Sanskrit-side and Urdu-side rather than formal and casual — register in Hindi is not one ladder. सूचित joins सूचना, सूची and सूचक in one family. And निवेदन है कि is how a request addressed upwards begins.
summary.next_up_en: Next: the three lines at the top of every official Hindi letter.

learn.title_en: संदर्भ — the first line of an official letter
learn.explanation_en: An Indian official letter opens with three labelled lines, and this is the first: संदर्भ, reference, pointing at whatever earlier letter or order this one answers. संदर्भ also means context in general — इस संदर्भ में, in this connection — and both senses come from the same idea of something being placed alongside. It is masculine and consonant-final, so flag it. Learn the three header words together and you can orient yourself in any official Hindi document in about five seconds.

examples.note: The header line as it actually appears.

examples.hindi: इस संदर्भ में कुछ कहना है।
examples.read_as: is saṁdarbh meṁ kuchh kahnaa hai.
examples.english: There is something to say in this connection.
examples.note: इस, oblique before में.

examples.hindi: उसने बिना संदर्भ के बात की।
examples.read_as: usne binaa saṁdarbh ke baat kii.
examples.note: बिना ... के, the wrap-around "without" from level 15.

common_error.why_en: संदर्भ takes में in this phrase, like राय.

practice.prompt_en: संदर्भ: at the top of a letter means what?
practice.explanation_en: It points at the earlier document this letter answers.

game.question_en: Which word means a hint or signal?
game.explanation_en: संकेत is a signal or hint. संदेश is a message and संपर्क is contact.

tts_strings: इस संदर्भ में कुछ कहना है।
उसने बिना संदर्भ के बात की।

learn.title_en: विषय — the subject line, and the subject at school
learn.explanation_en: विषय is the second header line, the subject of the letter, and it is the same word used for a subject you study and a topic under discussion. Where English keeps subject-of-a-letter and subject-at-school apart in feel, Hindi does not bother. It is masculine and consonant-final, so flag it. In email specifically you will also see the English सब्जेक्ट, which is entirely normal and which Module 15 will place properly.

examples.note: आवेदन — an application, another formal noun.
पसंदीदा, favourite — invariable despite the -आ ending, because it is a Persian form.

examples.english: This is a very big topic.
examples.note: बड़ा agreeing with masculine विषय.

practice.prompt_en: विषय does NOT mean which of these?
practice.explanation_en: English "subject" also means a citizen. Hindi's विषय never does.

game.question_en: Which word means a heading or title?
game.explanation_en: शीर्षक is a title or headline. अध्याय is a chapter.

learn.title_en: दिनांक is masculine and तारीख़ is feminine
learn.explanation_en: दिनांक is दिन (day) plus अंक (number), and it is the third header line. It is masculine and consonant-final, so flag it. Its everyday partner is तारीख़ — and here is the trap: the two words mean the same thing and have opposite genders. दिनांक is masculine, तारीख़ is feminine, so आज का दिनांक but आज की तारीख़. Register pairs usually leave the grammar alone; this one does not, and it is the kind of thing that only catches you once you have started using the formal word.

examples.note: The third header line.
की, because तारीख़ is feminine.

examples.hindi: ये पत्र दिनांक 3 जून का है।
examples.read_as: ye patra dinaaṁk 3 juun kaa hai.
examples.note: का, because दिनांक is masculine.

common_error.why_en: तारीख़ is feminine. दिनांक, meaning the same thing, is masculine.

practice.explanation_en: Same meaning, opposite genders — which makes this pair unusual.

game.question_en: Which word is used for a date in a traditional or religious calendar?
game.explanation_en: तिथि is the Sanskrit word, used for calendar dates in religious and traditional contexts. अवधि is a period, from level 16.

summary.recap_en: संदर्भ, विषय and दिनांक are the three labelled lines at the top of every official Hindi letter, and learning them together orients you in any document in seconds. And दिनांक against तारीख़ is a register pair where the gender changes with the register, which is rare enough to be a genuine trap.
summary.next_up_en: Next: how such a letter ends — and the module's first "with" prefix, after four ways of saying "without".

learn.explanation_en: हस्त is hand and अक्षर is a letter of the alphabet, so a signature is hand-lettering. It is masculine and consonant-final, so flag it, and it goes with करना: यहाँ हस्ताक्षर करें. The everyday word is दस्तख़त, Urdu-side and also masculine, and it is what a bank clerk will actually say to you. Both are in daily use; the form says one and the person says the other.

examples.note: On a form. A clerk would say यहाँ दस्तख़त कर दीजिए.

examples.hindi: बिना हस्ताक्षर के फ़ॉर्म अधूरा है।
examples.read_as: binaa hastaakṣar ke fôrm adhuuraa hai.
examples.english: The form is incomplete without a signature.
examples.note: बिना ... के again, and अधूरा agreeing with masculine फ़ॉर्म.
दस्तख़त is treated as plural here, which is normal.

common_error.wrong: यहाँ हस्ताक्षर करो — said to an official
common_error.why_en: The word is formal, so the verb form around it should be too. Mixing a formal noun with a तुम imperative sounds wrong in both directions.

practice.prompt_en: हस्ताक्षर is built from which two parts?
practice.explanation_en: हस्त, hand, plus अक्षर, a letter of the alphabet.

game.explanation_en: हस्तलेख is handwriting. दस्तख़त is a signature like हस्ताक्षर, and मुहर is a seal or stamp.

learn.title_en: प्रयास — the formal partner of कोशिश
learn.explanation_en: You met प्रयास back in level 1, as the answer to the question about what an official notice would use instead of कोशिश. Here it is properly: an effort or attempt, masculine, consonant-final, so flag it. It goes with करना like कोशिश does, and the difference between them is purely one of setting. A report says सभी प्रयास किए गए; a person says मैंने बहुत कोशिश की.

examples.note: पूरा and किया both masculine, agreeing with प्रयास.
Plural, so रहे. विफल — unsuccessful, invariable.
जारी from the wet-floor sign in level 6.

common_error.why_en: प्रयास is masculine, where कोशिश is feminine. Swapping the register also swaps the agreement.

practice.prompt_en: What is the everyday equivalent of प्रयास?
practice.explanation_en: कोशिश, from level 1 — and note it is feminine while प्रयास is masculine.

game.question_en: Which word means sustained hard work rather than an attempt?
game.explanation_en: मेहनत is labour put in. प्रयास and कोशिश are both attempts, and इरादा is an intention.

learn.title_en: स- means "with" — the first positive prefix in the module
learn.explanation_en: सादर is स- (with) plus आदर (respect), so it means respectfully — and it is the word an Indian letter signs off with, where English says Yours sincerely. This is the module's first prefix that adds something rather than taking it away. You now have four ways of saying without — निः-, ला-, अ- and बिना — and exactly one way of saying with. The स- family is small but worth recognising: सहर्ष with joy, सप्रेम with love, सफल with fruit and so successful, सक्षम capable.

examples.note: The closing line of a formal letter, on its own.
A formal spoken or written greeting, common at the start of a speech.
सहर्ष — with joy. The same prefix, and you will meet it again in a reading item at level 31.

common_error.why_en: सादर belongs to a formal letter, so the rest of the sign-off has to match. To a friend you would not use सादर at all.

practice.prompt_en: What does the prefix स- mean?
practice.explanation_en: सादर with respect, सहर्ष with joy, सप्रेम with love.

game.explanation_en: हर्ष is joy, so सहर्ष is gladly. सफल is successful and सक्षम is capable.

summary.recap_en: हस्ताक्षर is hand-lettering, and दस्तख़त is what the clerk says. प्रयास is कोशिश in formal dress — and masculine, where कोशिश is feminine. And सादर introduces स-, the module's first prefix that adds rather than subtracts, after four different ways of saying without.
summary.next_up_en: Next: the third reading block — the last two signs, and the first messages.
